name: com.michaelo.oxgkit.tweensystem
description: The OxGKit is a system tool kit commonly used in game development based on Unity design (all are independent tools).

samples.description: Demonstrates DoTweenAnim tween tracks (position/rotation/scale/size/alpha/color) with Normal/Reverse/PingPong/Sequence play modes, driven by DoTweenAnimEvent PlayNormal/PlayReverse/PlayTrigger with end callbacks.

Agent Skill (SKILL.md) that teaches AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, etc.) how to use the TweenSystem: DoTweenAnim track authoring, DoTweenAnimEvent playback with callbacks, DOTween assembly setup, and the GUID fix. Copy the skill folder into your agent's skills directory after import (see the sample's README).
